Jev could reduce cost for structured review tagging or evidence selection. Reviq already produces neutral topics plus exact excerpts, so Jev could select review/sentence IDs and Kotlin could render the original text.

Recommend benchmarking one structured selection call against current chat before switching—especially source accuracy, refusals, injection resistance, total cost, and latency. Keep source validation and existing security controls.
